Hi Santiago — thanks for sending the docs. Quick answers up front, then a checklist: 

- Fiscal rep: Not required for an EU-established supplier invoicing from Spain to Redwood's EU entity. Fiscal rep is only required when a non-EU supplier does not have an EU VAT registration and needs an EU agent.
- PO currency: Our EMEA POs are issued in EUR for EU vendors. Occasionally we send USD when the contract stipulates global billing; we'll flag that on the PO's "currency" field.
- Reverse charge wording: If reverse charge applies, the invoice should include the phrase: "Reverse charge — intra-community supply (Art. 194, Council Directive 2006/112/EC)." We also accept a Redwood-specific tax_code: REV_CHG and the net/gross split.

Vendor onboarding checklist (minimal required items for AP / PO enablement):
- Completed vendor master form (DocuSign) — link below.
- Company legal name exactly as on tax register.
- VAT number / NIF (we will validate via VIES).
- Registered address + proof (PDF).
- Sample invoice showing line-level VAT or net with reverse charge note.
- Bank details (IBAN + BIC) and confirmation page.

I've attached our standard Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist_v2.xlsx and a sample PO field mapping doc. Two action items for you: 1) upload the invoice and VAT cert to the secure portal (or reply with them attached) and 2) sign the vendor form via DocuSign (https://docusign.com/link/abc123-onboard-valencia).

I'll loop Ben to confirm the PO field names we expect from your ERP so you can configure an automated mapping.

Best,

Hi Santiago — Ben from Finance here. A few practical notes that will speed up PO / AP processing: 

1) Required invoice header fields (minimal):
   - CompanyLegalName
   - VATNumber (NIF)
   - InvoiceNumber
   - InvoiceDate (ISO yyyy-mm-dd)
   - Currency
   - LineItemDescription
   - NetAmountPerLine
   - VATAmountPerLine (if applicable)
   - PaymentTerms

2) Reverse charge handling: If net is subject to reverse charge, include these two identifiers on the invoice: 
   - TaxNote: "Reverse charge — intra-community supply (Art. 194, 2006/112/EC)"
   - RedwoodTaxCode: REV_CHG
We will map TaxNote -> invoice_comments and RedwoodTaxCode -> tax_code in our AP system. Adding a free-text "TaxNote" is helpful.

3) Withholding tax: For EU-to-EU B2B supplies between VAT-registered entities, withholding tax typically does not apply. If you invoice from outside the EU or for royalties/licensing we may need a tax residency certificate. We will confirm with tax counsel if a specific service line could trigger domestic withholding, but for standard goods/installation that shouldn't be an issue.

4) PO field mapping sample (we can accept CSV/XML exports):
   - VendorERP.CompanyName -> CompanyLegalName
   - VendorERP.TaxID -> VATNumber
   - VendorERP.InvoiceRef -> InvoiceNumber
   - VendorERP.CurrencyCode -> Currency
   - VendorERP.LineText -> LineItemDescription
   - VendorERP.LineNet -> NetAmountPerLine
   - VendorERP.LineTax -> VATAmountPerLine

Next steps: we've authorized AP to create a provisional vendor record and will push EMEA PO templates in EUR. Please confirm your preferred remittance IBAN and we'll finalize bank verification.

Regards,
Ben Carter
EU Accounts Payable Manager
Redwood Inference
